notes: Existing valid claims remain owned by their current agents and are not migrated mid-task.
New claims must continue to the next eligible task unless a documented stop condition applies.
Only verified witnessGIT management-account Agents may fix bugs or modify the protected control plane; unknown identity defaults to worker.
Worker Agents execute claimed business tasks and submit bugs to coordination/bug_reports/; they do not repair project machinery.
A single GitHub create_file 422 or 409 must be classified against fresh repository state before it can become a write error.
If the exact claim exists after a failed create, classify CLAIM_RACE_LOST, refresh state, and try another eligible task immediately.
If a 409 leaves the exact claim absent, classify a moving-branch retry, refresh main, short-backoff, and retry against fresh state.
Only classify GITHUB_WRITE_ERROR when the exact claim remains absent after fresh bounded retries and no race/staleness/moving-main explanation applies.
External prompts should not duplicate project requirements; Agents must load them from the repository.
A minimal prompt containing only the repository address and an instruction to start work is sufficient.
Git provides durable coordination and resume state; it cannot revive a host-suspended ChatGPT/Work/Codex session.
An S-AUDIT completion or coordination/ready/audit marker does not by itself contribute a Pilot-60 playback check.

Real playback work is retryable and independent through scripts/playback_queue.py; blocked runtime attempts release the case for later retry instead of converting transcript checks into playback evidence.

A playback claim now requires ffmpeg, ffprobe, and an explicit --content-inspection-capable declaration; a runtime that can run commands but cannot inspect decoded content must not claim a playback case.
Pilot-60 counts only canonical-crosschecked data/playback_audits records created after successful real-media decode plus actual content inspection with observed position and timing error.
P9-AUDIT-60 remains blocked until scripts/audit_gate.py passes and scripts/playback_queue.py --seal-gate creates P9-PLAYBACK-GATE.
If ordinary work is empty but playback work remains, repository-wide NO_ELIGIBLE_WORK is false; a non-media runtime may only classify its own session as HOST_STOP/runtime capability limitation.

Missing shell/media execution or inability to inspect generated clips is HOST_STOP/runtime capability limitation; SAFETY_OR_ACCESS_BLOCK is reserved for access that would require bypassing login, CAPTCHA, paywall, DRM, or other controls.
